description: Manage departments, goals, agent reporting lines, and project responsibilities.
managerRequired: Only team owners and managers can view and edit the organization.

goals.empty: No organization goals have been created.

agents.projectInstructionsPlaceholder: Describe this agent's responsibility in the project.
agents.capabilitiesHint: Lowercase words separated by commas. A task whose labels match the capabilities of exactly one specialist goes to that specialist without the coordinator's plan.

projects.instructionsPlaceholder: Describe the project's mandate and operating instructions.

resources.title: Project resources
resources.description: Provisioned code, terminal, browser, files, and agent resources for this project.

orchestration.teamDescription: Roles and capabilities apply to every project of the team. Only agents that run in Hermes take part in a team run.
orchestration.editRoles: Set roles and capabilities on the Agents tab.
orchestration.policyDescription: Runs in Mastra when a task is delegated to a coordinator.
orchestration.unavailable: The workflow list is not available. Check that Mastra is running.
orchestration.offHint: Off for this project: a task delegated to a coordinator is queued for that agent alone.

warnings.noCoordinator: No Hermes agent has the coordinator role, so a delegated task starts no team run.
warnings.severalCoordinators: Several coordinators: the one the task is delegated to leads the run.
warnings.noSpecialists: No specialists: the coordinator does the work itself.

flow.title: How a task reaches the agents
flow.direct: A chat, an @mention or a task assigned to one agent goes straight to that agent in Hermes.
flow.team: A task delegated to a coordinator, or started from the task's Agent team section, runs in Mastra:

stages.coordinate: The coordinator splits the task into assignments.
stages.specialize: Specialists work on them in Hermes, independent ones in parallel.
stages.synchronize: The summary and evidence are written to the task, which moves to Review or Done.

flow.route: When the task's labels match the capabilities of exactly one specialist, or the project has only one, Mastra skips the plan and assigns the task directly.
